name: SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support
tagline: EDGE SUPPORT FOR PAVER DESIGNS ON HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM
summary: SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support is a support system used on top of adjustable pedestals to cantilever, bridge and support irregular pavers in raised flooring systems. Joists are manufactured from aluminium, and its proprietary design allows for installation of narrow or non-right angled pavers to be installed along perimeter wall, bridge over obstructions on the roof, and support odd-shaped pavers to achieve unique patterns and layouts of raised flooring. SikaRoof® VersiFrame Edge Support is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and has three rails to maximise variation in spacer tab placement to support as many unique paver designs as possible.
